material_definitions: The study focuses on aliovalent doping in Li+ conducting argyrodites.
Solid solutions of the type Li(6+x)P(1-x)Si(x)S5X were investigated by substituting P5+ with Si4+.
The doping increases the Li+ concentration and the unit cell size.
This substitution leads to a rising occupancy of Li+ on the transition state for hopping.
warnings: Conductivity value is a lower bound (>2 mS/cm) extracted as 2 mS/cm.
Measurement temperature is inferred as room temperature (25 C) since none was specified.

material_definitions: The solid solutions investigated are $\mathrm{Li}_{6+x}\mathrm{P}_{1-x}\mathrm{Si}_x\mathrm{S}_5\mathrm{Br}$ argyrodite superionics.
Ionic conductivity measurements were performed using temperature-dependent impedance spectroscopy.
The materials involve aliovalent substitution of $\mathrm{P}^{5+}$ by $\mathrm{Si}^{4+}$ to optimize the ionic conductivity.
The highest conductivity was observed at $x=0.35$ due to increased $\mathrm{Li}^{+}$ content.
warnings: Raw temperature value (25) and unit (C) are inferred from the descriptor 'room-temperature'.
